text: Now in this initiation of our studies in their progress, whatsoever presents itself before us is book sufficient; a roguish trick of a page, a sottish mistake of a servant, a jest at the table, are so many new subjects.
author: Michel de Montaigne
locator: Book I, Chapter 25, Of the Education of Children
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
